Table.name: EMSPrograms
Table.Row: #1 #Building Average Zone Air Temperature #1 #Calculate building average zone temperature for the occupied zones #0 #! report average air temperature of all occupied zones in building ^^! for all occupied zones create sensors and internal variables for temperature and zone air volume respectively^<ForAllOccupiedZones>, ^EnergyManagementSystem:Sensor,^ Temp_<LoopZoneVariableName>, ^ <LoopZoneIDFName> ,^ Zone Mean Air Temperature ; ^^EnergyManagementSystem:InternalVariable,^ Vol_<LoopZoneVariableName>, ^ <LoopZoneIDFName> ,^ Zone Air Volume;^<LoopNextZone>^ ^EnergyManagementSystem:ProgramCallingManager,^ Average Building Temperature , ! Name^ EndOfZoneTimestepBeforeZoneReporting , ! EnergyPlus Model Calling Point^ AverageZoneTemps ; ! Program Name 1^ ^EnergyManagementSystem:GlobalVariable,^ AverageBuildingTemp;^ ^EnergyManagementSystem:OutputVariable,^ Average Building Zone Air Temperature [C],^ AverageBuildingTemp, ^ Averaged, ^ ZoneTimeStep ; ^ ^EnergyManagementSystem:Program,^ AverageZoneTemps,^ ! initialise^ SET SumNumerator = 0,^ SET SumDenominator = 0,^<ForAllOccupiedZones>,^ ! example of generating a fatal error if variables go out of bounds^ ! in this case air temp must be < 100degC and > -100degC in all zones^ If Temp_<LoopZoneVariableName> > 100 _OR_ Temp_<LoopZoneVariableName> < 0.0-100,^ SET tmpError = @FatalHaltEp 999.9,^ ENDIF,^ ! calculate the average temperature and save to AverageBuildingTemp^ SET SumNumerator = SumNumerator + Temp_<LoopZoneVariableName> * Vol_<LoopZoneVariableName>,^ SET SumDenominator = SumDenominator + Vol_<LoopZoneVariableName>,^<LoopNextZone>^ IF SumDenominator > 0,^ SET AverageBuildingTemp = SumNumerator / SumDenominator,^ ENDIF;^^! provide outputs based on DB output settings^<If BuildingAttribute TimesteplyOutput = 1 Then> ^Output:Variable, *, Average Building Zone Air Temperature, timestep; ^<Endif>^<If BuildingAttribute HourlyOutput = 1 Then> ^Output:Variable, *, Average Building Zone Air Temperature, hourly; ^<Endif>^<If BuildingAttribute DailyOutput = 1 Then> ^Output:Variable, *, Average Building Zone Air Temperature, daily; ^<Endif>^<If BuildingAttribute MonthlyOutput = 1 Then> ^Output:Variable, *, Average Building Zone Air Temperature, monthly; ^<Endif>

#2 #Change Heating and Cooling Setpoints Daily #1 #Change the setpoints based on the day of the week. #0 #!-Change the setpoint temperature of cooling and heating based on the day of the week ^ ^<ForAllOccupiedZones>^EnergyManagementSystem:Actuator,^ Schedule_Value_<LoopZoneVariableName>_COOLING_SP_SCH,^ <LoopZoneIDFName> COOLING SP SCH,^ Schedule:Compact,^ Schedule Value;^^EnergyManagementSystem:Actuator,^ Schedule_Value_<LoopZoneVariableName>_HEATING_SETPOINT_SCHEDULE,^ <LoopZoneIDFName> HEATING SETPOINT SCHEDULE,^ Schedule:Compact,^ Schedule Value;^<LoopNextZone>^^EnergyManagementSystem:ProgramCallingManager,^ My_Setpoint_Schedule_Calculator_Example,^ BeginTimestepBeforePredictor,^ MyComputedCoolingSetpointProg,^ MyComputedHeatingSetpointProg;^^EnergyManagementSystem:Program,^ MyComputedCoolingSetpointProg,^ IF DayOfWeek < 6 && Holiday == 0,^<ForAllOccupiedZones>^ Set Schedule_Value_<LoopZoneVariableName>_COOLING_SP_SCH = 26.0,^<LoopNextZone>^ Else,^<ForAllOccupiedZones>^ Set Schedule_Value_<LoopZoneVariableName>_COOLING_SP_SCH = 100.0,^<LoopNextZone>^ Endif;^^EnergyManagementSystem:Program,^ MyComputedHeatingSetpointProg,^ IF DayOfWeek < 6 && Holiday == 0,^<ForAllOccupiedZones>^ Set Schedule_Value_<LoopZoneVariableName>_HEATING_SETPOINT_SCHEDULE = 21.0,^<LoopNextZone>^ Else,^<ForAllOccupiedZones>^ Set Schedule_Value_<LoopZoneVariableName>_HEATING_SETPOINT_SCHEDULE = 15.0,^<LoopNextZone>^ Endif;

CIBSE_TM52 Maximum allowable inside operative temperature^<If BuildingAttribute SSCIBSETM52SuggestedAcceptableRange = I Then>^ SET TMax_TM52 = 0.33 * Running_Average_Outdoor_Air_Temperature_TM52 + 20.8,^<Endif>^<If BuildingAttribute SSCIBSETM52SuggestedAcceptableRange = II Then>^ SET TMax_TM52 = 0.33 * Running_Average_Outdoor_Air_Temperature_TM52 + 21.8,^ <Endif>^<If BuildingAttribute SSCIBSETM52SuggestedAcceptableRange = III Then>^ SET TMax_TM52 = 0.33 * Running_Average_Outdoor_Air_Temperature_TM52 + 22.8,^<Endif>^<If BuildingAttribute SSCIBSETM52SuggestedAcceptableRange = IV Then>^ SET TMax_TM52 = 0.33 * Running_Average_Outdoor_Air_Temperature_TM52 + 23.8,^<Endif>^^<ForAllOccupiedNonCooledZones>, ^ ! Set up the zone TM52OccSchedule which has value 1 when zone is occupied, it's TM52 summertime and the adaptive model temperature is in range^ If Adaptive_Model_Temperature == -1,^ Set <LoopZoneVariableName>_TM52_OccSchedule = 0,^<If SiteAttribute Latitude > 0 Then>^ Elseif Month <= 4 _OR_ Month >= 10,^<Endif>^<If SiteAttribute Latitude <= 0 Then>^ Elseif Month < 11 && Month > 3,^<Endif>^ Set <LoopZoneVariableName>_TM52_OccSchedule = 0,^ Else,^ Set <LoopZoneVariableName>_TM52_OccSchedule = <LoopZoneVariableName>OccSchedule,^ Endif,^^ ! Calculate CIBSE_TM52 Delta T for this timestep^ SET Tmp = @Round(<LoopZoneVariableName>_Op_Temp - TMax_TM52),^ SET <LoopZoneVariableName>_DeltaT = Tmp,^ ! ensure the Delta >= 0^ IF <LoopZoneVariableName>_DeltaT < 0 ,^ SET <LoopZoneVariableName>_DeltaT = 0,^ ENDIF,^ ^ IF <LoopZoneVariableName>_DeltaT > 0,^ ! uncomfortable^ SET <LoopZoneVariableName>_C1 = 100,^ ELSE,^ ! comfortable^ SET <LoopZoneVariableName>_C1 = 0,^ ENDIF, ^^ ! store discomfort time in criterion 2 variable ^ ! this output should be viewed at daily frequency to check for compliance with criterion 2^ SET Tmp = <LoopZoneVariableName>_DeltaT,^ SET <LoopZoneVariableName>_C2 = Tmp * ZoneTimeStep,^ ^ ! If deltaT > 4 then criterion 3 is failed^ IF <LoopZoneVariableName>_DeltaT > 4,^ SET <LoopZoneVariableName>_C3 = ZoneTimeStep,^ ELSE,^ SET <LoopZoneVariableName>_C3 = 0,^ ENDIF,^<LoopNextZone>;^^EnergyManagementSystem:Sensor,^ Site_Outdoor_Air_Drybulb_Temperature_TM52,^ Environment,^ Site Outdoor Air Drybulb Temperature;^^EnergyManagementSystem:Sensor,^ CEN_15251_Adaptive_Model_Running_Average_Outdoor_Air_Temperature_TM52,^ People <Any_Occupied_ZoneIDFName>,^ Zone Thermal Comfort CEN 15251 Adaptive Model Running Average Outdoor Air Temperature;^^EnergyManagementSystem:GlobalVariable, Running_Average_Outdoor_Air_Temperature_TM52;^EnergyManagementSystem:GlobalVariable, Outdoor_Air_Temperature_TM52;^EnergyManagementSystem:GlobalVariable, StepCounter_TM52;^EnergyManagementSystem:GlobalVariable, Alpha_TM52;^^EnergyManagementSystem:TrendVariable,^ AvgTemptrendLog_TM52, !- Name^ Outdoor_Air_Temperature_TM52, !- EMS Variable Name^ 1440; !- Number of Timesteps to be Logged^^EnergyManagementSystem:OutputVariable,^ LastDayAverage_TM52, ! Type of Data in Variable^ ZoneTimeStep,^ CalculateRunningAverage_TM52,^ [C];^^EnergyManagementSystem:ProgramCallingManager,^ InitVariablesManager_TM52,^ BeginNewEnvironment,^ InitVariables_TM52;^^EnergyManagementSystem:Program,^ InitVariables_TM52,^ SET Alpha_TM52 = 0.8,^ SET StepCounter_TM52 = 0,^ SET Running_Average_Outdoor_Air_Temperature_TM52 = 0;^^EnergyManagementSystem:ProgramCallingManager,^ BeginTimestepManager_TM52,^ BeginTimestepBeforePredictor,^ CalculateRunningAverage_TM52;^^EnergyManagementSystem:Program,^ CalculateRunningAverage_TM52,^ IF StepCounter_TM52 < 24 / ZoneTimestep,^ SET Running_Average_Outdoor_Air_Temperature_TM52 = CEN_15251_Adaptive_Model_Running_Average_Outdoor_Air_Temperature_TM52,^ ELSEIF CurrentTime == ZoneTimestep,^ SET LastDayAverage_TM52 = @TrendAverage Outdoor_Air_Temperature_TM52 24 / Zonetimestep,^ SET Running_Average_Outdoor_Air_Temperature_TM52 = Alpha_TM52 * Running_Average_Outdoor_Air_Temperature_TM52 + (1 - Alpha_TM52) * LastDayAverage_TM52,^ ELSE,^ SET Running_Average_Outdoor_Air_Temperature_TM52 = Running_Average_Outdoor_Air_Temperature_TM52,^ ENDIF,^ IF WarmupFlag == False,^ SET StepCounter_TM52 = StepCounter_TM52 + 1,^ ENDIF,^ SET Outdoor_Air_Temperature_TM52 = Site_Outdoor_Air_Drybulb_Temperature_TM52;^^EnergyManagementSystem:ProgramCallingManager,^ SetFirstValueManager_TM52,^ EndOfZoneTimestepBeforeZoneReporting,^ SetFirstValue_TM52;^^EnergyManagementSystem:Program,^ SetFirstValue_TM52,^ IF StepCounter_TM52 == 1,^ SET Running_Average_Outdoor_Air_Temperature_TM52 = CEN_15251_Adaptive_Model_Running_Average_Outdoor_Air_Temperature_TM52,^ ENDIF;^

#5 #Optimum start heating control (domestic) #1 #Override heating setpoint schedule for all heated zones using setback until optimum startup time #0 #EnergyManagementSystem:GlobalVariable, CurrentOptimumStartTime;^^EnergyManagementSystem:ProgramCallingManager,^ OptimumStartCM,^ BeginTimestepBeforePredictor,^ SetOptimumStart;^^EnergyManagementSystem:ProgramCallingManager,^ InitConstants, ^ BeginNewEnvironment, ^ Init;^^EnergyManagementSystem:Program,^ Init,^ SET CurrentOptimumStartTime = 7;^^EnergyManagementSystem:Sensor,^ SiteOutdoorAirDrybulbTemperature,^ Environment,^ Site Outdoor Air Drybulb Temperature;^^<ForAllOccupiedHeatedZones>^EnergyManagementSystem:Actuator,^ <LoopZoneVariableName>HeatingSetpointSchedule,^ <LoopZoneIDFName> Heating Setpoint Schedule,^ Schedule:Compact,^ Schedule Value; ^<LoopNextZone>^^! set optimimum start time^EnergyManagementSystem:Program,^ SetOptimumStart,^ ! set the optimum start time at 1am^ IF (CurrentTime == 1),^ SET Tos = SiteOutdoorAirDrybulbTemperature,^ ! outside temp for earliest start time^ SET TosMin = 0,^ ! earliest start time^ SET TimeTosMin = 5,^ ! outside temp for latest start time^ SET TosMax = 10, ^ ! latest start time^ SET TimeTosMax = 7,^ IF (Tos <= TosMin),^ SET Time = TimeTosMin,^ ELSEIF (Tos >= TosMax),^ SET Time = TimeTosMax,^ ELSE,^ SET m = (TimeTosMax - TimeTosMin) / (TosMax - TosMin), ^ SET C = (TimeTosMin + TimeTosMax - m * (TosMin + TosMax)) / 2,^ SET Time = m * Tos + C,^ ENDIF,^ SET CurrentOptimumStartTime = Time,^ ENDIF,^^! override heating setpoint schedule: setback until optimum startup time, setpoint until 10, setback until 16, setpoint until 23^<ForAllOccupiedHeatedZones>^ If (CurrentTime < CurrentOptimumStartTime),^ SET <LoopZoneVariableName>HeatingSetpointSchedule = <LoopZoneAttribute HeatingSetBackSetPointTemperature>,^ ELSEIF (CurrentTime < 10),^ SET <LoopZoneVariableName>HeatingSetpointSchedule = <LoopZoneAttribute HeatingDesignSetPointTemperature>,^ ELSEIF (CurrentTime < 16),^ SET <LoopZoneVariableName>HeatingSetpointSchedule = <LoopZoneAttribute HeatingSetBackSetPointTemperature>,^ ELSEIF (CurrentTime < 23),^ SET <LoopZoneVariableName>HeatingSetpointSchedule = <LoopZoneAttribute HeatingDesignSetPointTemperature>,^ ELSE,^ SET <LoopZoneVariableName>HeatingSetpointSchedule = <LoopZoneAttribute HeatingSetBackSetPointTemperature>,^ ENDIF,^<LoopNextZone>;^^EnergyManagementSystem:OutputVariable,^ Optimum Start Time, ^ CurrentOptimumStartTime, ^ Averaged, ^ ZoneTimeStep ; ^^<If BuildingAttribute TimesteplyOutput = 1 Then> ^Output:Variable,^ *, ^ Optimum Start Time, ^ timestep; ^<Endif>^<If BuildingAttribute HourlyOutput = 1 Then> ^Output:Variable,^ *, ^ Optimum Start Time, ^ hourly; ^<Endif> ^

#8 #CO2 control (On/Off) #1 #Control external windows in nat vent zone to open fully when CO2 levels are higher than setpoint #0 #! Program requires:^! - Calculated natural ventilation^! - CO2 control switched on at site level^! windows are fully opened when the zone CO2 levels > 1000ppm based on opening availability and when Nat vent on at zone level ^^<ForAllExternalWindows>^EnergyManagementSystem:Sensor,^ <LoopWindowVariableName>Air_CO2_Concentration,^ <LoopWindowZoneIDFName>,^ Zone Air CO2 Concentration;^^EnergyManagementSystem:Actuator,^ Venting_Opening_Factor_<LoopWindowVariableName>,^ <LoopWindowIDFName>,^ AirFlow Network Window/Door Opening,^ Venting Opening Factor;^<LoopNextWindow>^^! extra outputs for viewing in the results viewer^<If BuildingAttribute HourlyOutput = 1 Then>^Output:Variable, *, Zone Air CO2 Concentration, hourly; ^<Endif>^<If BuildingAttribute TimesteplyOutput = 1 Then>^Output:Variable, *, Zone Air CO2 Concentration, timestep; ^<Endif>^^EnergyManagementSystem:ProgramCallingManager,^ CO2 Window Control,^ InsideHVACSystemIterationLoop,^ CO2WindowControl;^^EnergyManagementSystem:Program,^ CO2WindowControl,^<ForAllExternalWindows>^ ! on/off control of window opening factor^ If <LoopWindowVariableName>Air_CO2_Concentration > 1000,^ Set Venting_Opening_Factor_<LoopWindowVariableName> = 1,^ Else,^ Set Venting_Opening_Factor_<LoopWindowVariableName> = 0,^ Endif,^<LoopNextWindow>;

#9 #CO2 control (Proportional) #1 #Vary external window opening area in a nat vent zone based on CO2 levels using proportional control #0 #! Program requires:^! - Calculated natural ventilation^! - CO2 control switched on at site level^! window opening factor is controlled using linear (proportional) control based on internal CO2 levels^^<ForAllExternalWindows>^EnergyManagementSystem:Sensor,^ <LoopWindowVariableName>Air_CO2_Concentration,^ <LoopWindowZoneIDFName>,^ Zone Air CO2 Concentration;^^EnergyManagementSystem:Actuator,^ Venting_Opening_Factor_<LoopWindowVariableName>,^ <LoopWindowIDFName>,^ AirFlow Network Window/Door Opening,^ Venting Opening Factor;^<LoopNextWindow>^^! extra outputs for viewing in the results viewer^<If BuildingAttribute HourlyOutput = 1 Then>^Output:Variable, *, Zone Air CO2 Concentration, hourly; ^<Endif>^<If BuildingAttribute TimesteplyOutput = 1 Then>^Output:Variable, *, Zone Air CO2 Concentration, timestep; ^<Endif>^^EnergyManagementSystem:ProgramCallingManager,^ CO2 Window Control,^ InsideHVACSystemIterationLoop,^ CO2WindowControl;^^EnergyManagementSystem:Program,^ CO2WindowControl,^<ForAllExternalWindows>^ ! Proportional control of window opening^ ! CO2 levels in zone for this window^ SET ZoneCO2 = <LoopWindowVariableName>Air_CO2_Concentration,^ ! CO2 level giving rise to lowest opening factor^ SET ZoneCO2Min = 900,^ ! Lowest opening factor^ SET OpenFactZoneCO2Min = 0,^ ! CO2 level giving rise to highest opening factor^ SET ZoneCO2Max = 1000, ^ ! Highest opening factor^ SET OpenFactZoneCO2Max = 1,^ IF ZoneCO2 <= ZoneCO2Min,^ SET OpenFact = OpenFactZoneCO2Min,^ ELSEIF ZoneCO2 >= ZoneCO2Max,^ SET OpenFact = OpenFactZoneCO2Max,^ ELSE,^ SET m = (OpenFactZoneCO2Max - OpenFactZoneCO2Min) / (ZoneCO2Max - ZoneCO2Min), ^ SET C = (OpenFactZoneCO2Min + OpenFactZoneCO2Max - m * (ZoneCO2Min + ZoneCO2Max)) / 2,^ SET OpenFact = m * ZoneCO2 + C,^ ENDIF,^ SET Venting_Opening_Factor_<LoopWindowVariableName> = OpenFact,^<LoopNextWindow>;

#10 #L5 HR Bypass ZoneVentilation #1 #Bypass heat recovery when cooling is active by introducing additional mech vent outside air #0 #! bypass heat recovery when cooling is active by introducing additional mech vent outside air. ^! This makes up the total mech vent to the value it would need to give the thermal effect of no HR^ ^<ForAllL5HRZonesWithCooling>^EnergyManagementSystem:Actuator,^ Schedule_Value_<LoopZoneVariableName>_HR_COOLING_BYPASS,^ <LoopZoneIDFName> HR COOLING BYPASS SCH,^ Schedule:Compact,^ Schedule Value;^<LoopNextZone>^^<ForAllL5HRZonesWithCooling>^EnergyManagementSystem:Sensor,^ CoolingLoad_<LoopZoneVariableName>,^ <LoopZoneIDFName> Ideal Loads Air,^ Zone Ideal Loads Supply Air Sensible Cooling Rate;^<LoopNextZone>^^EnergyManagementSystem:ProgramCallingManager,^ HRByPass,^ BeginTimestepBeforePredictor,^ HRByPassProg;^^EnergyManagementSystem:Program,^ HRByPassProg,^<ForAllL5HRZonesWithCooling>^ If CoolingLoad_<LoopZoneVariableName> > 0,^ Set Schedule_Value_<LoopZoneVariableName>_HR_COOLING_BYPASS = 1,^ Else,^ Set Schedule_Value_<LoopZoneVariableName>_HR_COOLING_BYPASS = 0,^ Endif,^<LoopNextZone>;

#11 #L5 HR Bypass IdealLoads #1 #Bypass heat recovery when cooling is active by introducing additional ideal loads outside air #0 #! Bypass heat recovery when cooling is active by introducing full ideal loads outside air. ^! HR modelled by changing outside air flow rate. The ideal loads HR is not used because that cannnot be adjusted^! When no cooling, there is no bypass, the HR is active and the outside air flow rate is reduced to account for the thermal effect of the HR reduced heat loss^! When cooling operates, bypass is activated and outside air flow rate takes on full (non-HR) value^! Need to model outdoor air with ideal loads to allow air extract luminaires to be modelled in E+ correctly. ^! ZoneVentilation method of accounting for HR does not allow air extract luminaires, but otherwise works well^^<ForAllL5HRZonesWithCooling>^EnergyManagementSystem:Actuator,^ Outdoor_Air_Mass_Flow_Rate_<LoopZoneVariableName>,^ <LoopZoneIDFName> IDEAL LOADS AIR,^ Ideal Loads Air System,^ Outdoor Air Mass Flow Rate;^^EnergyManagementSystem:Sensor,^ <LoopZoneVariableName>_Occ_Schedule,^ <LoopZoneAttribute OccupancySchedule>,^ Schedule Value;^^EnergyManagementSystem:Sensor,^ CoolingLoad_<LoopZoneVariableName>,^ <LoopZoneIDFName> Ideal Loads Air,^ Zone Ideal Loads Supply Air Sensible Cooling Rate;^<LoopNextZone>^^EnergyManagementSystem:ProgramCallingManager,^ HRByPass,^ BeginTimestepBeforePredictor,^ HRByPassProg;^^EnergyManagementSystem:Program,^ HRByPassProg,^ ! zone fresh air based directly on zone occupancy schedule^<ForAllL5HRZonesWithCooling>^ If <LoopZoneVariableName>_Occ_Schedule == 0,^ Set Outdoor_Air_Mass_Flow_Rate_<LoopZoneVariableName> = 0,^ ElseIf CoolingLoad_<LoopZoneVariableName> > 0,^ Set Outdoor_Air_Mass_Flow_Rate_<LoopZoneVariableName> = <LoopZoneAttribute L5HRBypassFreshAirFlowrate>,^ Else,^ Set Outdoor_Air_Mass_Flow_Rate_<LoopZoneVariableName> = <LoopZoneAttribute L5HRFreshAirFlowrate>,^ Endif,^<LoopNextZone>;

#12 #Optimum start heating control (non-domestic) #1 #Override heating setpoint schedule for all heated zones using setback until optimum startup time #0 #EnergyManagementSystem:GlobalVariable, CurrentOptimumStartTime;^^! calling manager for every timestep^EnergyManagementSystem:ProgramCallingManager,^ OptimumStartCM,^ BeginTimestepBeforePredictor,^ SetOptimumStart;^^! calling manager for every simulation^EnergyManagementSystem:ProgramCallingManager,^ InitConstants, ^ BeginNewEnvironment, ^ Init;^^! initialise at simulation start^EnergyManagementSystem:Program,^ Init,^ SET CurrentOptimumStartTime = 7;^^! sense outside air temperature^EnergyManagementSystem:Sensor,^ SiteOutdoorAirDrybulbTemperature,^ Environment,^ Site Outdoor Air Drybulb Temperature;^^! set up actuators based on the heating setpoint schedule for each heated zone (see IDF without EMS)^<ForAllOccupiedHeatedZones>^EnergyManagementSystem:Actuator,^ <LoopZoneVariableName>HeatingSetpointSchedule,^ <LoopZoneIDFName> Heating Setpoint Schedule,^ Schedule:Compact,^ Schedule Value; ^<LoopNextZone>^^! program called once per simulation timestep to set optimimum start time^! start times set up by overriding the heating setpoint temperature schedule for each heated zone based on the temperature at 1am^EnergyManagementSystem:Program,^ SetOptimumStart,^ ! set the optimum start time at 1am^ IF (CurrentTime == 1), ! use built in variable^ ! get current outdoor air temperature^ SET Tos = SiteOutdoorAirDrybulbTemperature,^ ! outside temp for earliest start time^ SET TosMin = 0,^ ! earliest start time^ SET TimeTosMin = 5,^ ! outside temp for latest start time^ SET TosMax = 15, ^ ! latest start time^ SET TimeTosMax = 7,^ IF (Tos <= TosMin),^ ! it's very cold outside so use earliest time^ SET Time = TimeTosMin,^ ELSEIF (Tos >= TosMax),^ ! it's warm outside so use latest time^ SET Time = TimeTosMax,^ ELSE,^ ! intermediate temperature so interpolate to find time^ SET m = (TimeTosMax - TimeTosMin) / (TosMax - TosMin), ^ SET C = (TimeTosMin + TimeTosMax - m * (TosMin + TosMax)) / 2,^ SET Time = m * Tos + C,^ ENDIF,^ ! store the calculated time for use in the code below^ SET CurrentOptimumStartTime = Time,^ ENDIF,^^! update the heating schedule for each heated zone based on the above-calculated optimum start time^! override heating setpoint schedule: setback until optimum startup time, then setpoint until 18:00, then setback until end of the day^<ForAllOccupiedHeatedZones>^ IF DayOfWeek == 7 _OR_ DayOfWeek == 1,^ SET <LoopZoneVariableName>HeatingSetpointSchedule = <LoopZoneAttribute HeatingSetBackSetPointTemperature>,^ ELSEIf (CurrentTime < CurrentOptimumStartTime),^ SET <LoopZoneVariableName>HeatingSetpointSchedule = <LoopZoneAttribute HeatingSetBackSetPointTemperature>,^ ELSEIF (CurrentTime < 18),^ SET <LoopZoneVariableName>HeatingSetpointSchedule = <LoopZoneAttribute HeatingDesignSetPointTemperature>,^ ELSE,^ SET <LoopZoneVariableName>HeatingSetpointSchedule = <LoopZoneAttribute HeatingSetBackSetPointTemperature>,^ ENDIF,^<LoopNextZone>;^^! some extra outputs for checking correct operation^EnergyManagementSystem:OutputVariable,^ Optimum Start Time, ^ CurrentOptimumStartTime, ^ Averaged, ^ ZoneTimeStep ; ^^<If BuildingAttribute TimesteplyOutput = 1 Then> ^Output:Variable,^ *, ^ Optimum Start Time, ^ timestep; ^<Endif>^<If BuildingAttribute HourlyOutput = 1 Then> ^Output:Variable,^ *, ^ Optimum Start Time, ^ hourly; ^<Endif> ^

#13 #Set external heat transfer coefficient #1 #Set the heat transfer coefficient for all external walls each timestep. #0 #|^EnergyManagementSystem:Sensor,|^ Site_Wind_Speed,|^ Environment,|^ Site Wind Speed;|^|^EnergyManagementSystem:Sensor,|^ Site_Outdoor_Air_Drybulb_Temperature,|^ Environment,|^ Site Outdoor Air Drybulb Temperature;|^|^<ForAllExternalSurfaces> {MinSlope = 89;MaxSlope=91}|^EnergyManagementSystem:Sensor,|^ Surface_Outside_Face_Temperature_<LoopSurfaceVariableName>,|^ <LoopSurfaceIDFName>,|^ Surface Outside Face Temperature;|^|^EnergyManagementSystem:Actuator,|^ h_<LoopSurfaceVariableName>,|^ <LoopSurfaceIDFName>,|^ Surface,|^ Exterior Surface Convection Heat Transfer Coefficient;|^|^Output:Variable, <LoopSurfaceIDFName>, Exterior Surface Convection Heat Transfer Coefficient, Hourly;|^<LoopNextSurface>|^|^EnergyManagementSystem:GlobalVariable,|^ DeltaT;|^EnergyManagementSystem:GlobalVariable,|^ DBTemp;|^EnergyManagementSystem:GlobalVariable,|^ FaceTemp;|^EnergyManagementSystem:GlobalVariable,|^ AbsT;|^EnergyManagementSystem:GlobalVariable,|^ CubeRoot;|^EnergyManagementSystem:GlobalVariable,|^ Coefficient;|^|^EnergyManagementSystem:ProgramCallingManager,|^ Example_Surface_Loop,|^ BeginTimestepBeforePredictor,|^ Calc_Exterior_Surface_Convection_Heat_Transfer_Coefficient;|^|^EnergyManagementSystem:Program,|^ Calc_Exterior_Surface_Convection_Heat_Transfer_Coefficient,|^ SET DBTemp = Site_Outdoor_Air_Drybulb_Temperature,|^ <ForAllExternalSurfaces> {MinSlope = 89;MaxSlope=91}|^ SET FaceTemp = Surface_Outside_Face_Temperature_<LoopSurfaceVariableName>,|^ SET DeltaT = DBTemp - FaceTemp,|^ SET AbsT = @Abs DeltaT,|^ SET CubeRoot = AbsT _POWER_ 1/3,|^ SET Coefficient = CubeRoot * 1.31,|^ SET h_<LoopSurfaceVariableName> = Coefficient,|^ <LoopNextSurface>;

#15 #CS example: EpNet IDF find and replace #2 #Demonstrates how to use EpNet to override the thermal absorptance value for no-mass materials #0 #using System.Collections.Generic;^using DB.Extensibility.Contracts;^using EpNet;^^namespace DB.Extensibility.Scripts^{^ public class IdfFindAndReplace : ScriptBase, IScript^ {^ public override void BeforeEnergySimulation()^ {^ IdfReader idfReader = new IdfReader(^ ApiEnvironment.EnergyPlusInputIdfPath,^ ApiEnvironment.EnergyPlusInputIddPath);^^ IEnumerable<IdfObject> noMassMaterials = idfReader["Material:NoMass"];^ foreach (IdfObject material in noMassMaterials)^ {^ material["Thermal Absorptance"].Value = (0.2).ToString();^ }^^ idfReader.Save();^ }^ }^}^

#16 #CS example: Load heating setpoints from template to model #2 #Load heating setpoints from an activity template to all office zones #0 #using System.Collections.Generic;^using System.Linq;^using DB.Api;^using DB.Extensibility.Contracts;^^namespace DB.Extensibility.Scripts^{^ public class LoadHeatingSetPoints : ScriptBase, IScript^ {^ const string SetPointTemperature = "HeatingDesignSetPointTemperature";^ ^ public override void BeforeEnergyIdfGeneration()^ {^ Site site = ApiEnvironment.Site;^ Table table = site.GetTable("ActivityTemplates");^ Record record = table.Records["Office_Typical"];^ string setPointTemp = record[SetPointTemperature];^^ SetSetPointTemperature1(site, setPointTemp);^ SetSetPointTemperature2(site, setPointTemp);^ SetSetPointTemperature3(site, setPointTemp);^ }^^ private void SetSetPointTemperature1(Site site, string setPointTemp)^ {^ foreach (Building building in site.Buildings)^ {^ foreach (BuildingBlock block in building.BuildingBlocks)^ {^ foreach (Zone zone in block.Zones)^ {^ string title = zone.GetAttribute("Title");^ if (title.Contains("office"))^ {^ zone.SetAttribute(SetPointTemperature, setPointTemp);^ }^ }^ }^ }^ }^^ private void SetSetPointTemperature2(Site site, string setPointTemp)^ {^ site.Buildings^ .SelectMany(building => building.BuildingBlocks)^ .SelectMany(block => block.Zones)^ .Where(zone => zone.GetAttribute("Title").Contains("office"))^ .ToList()^ .ForEach(zone => zone.SetAttribute(SetPointTemperature, setPointTemp));^ }^^ private void SetSetPointTemperature3(Site site, string setPointTemp)^ {^ IEnumerable<Zone> offices =^ from building in site.Buildings^ from block in building.BuildingBlocks^ from zone in block.Zones^ where zone.GetAttribute("Title").Contains("office")^ select zone;^^ foreach (Zone zone in offices)^ {^ zone.SetAttribute(SetPointTemperature, setPointTemp);^ }^ }^ }^}^

#104 #CS example: Custom Hook #2 #Custom Hook Example #0 #using System.Collections.Generic;^using System.Linq;^using System.Windows.Forms;^using DB.Api;^using DB.Extensibility.Contracts;^^namespace DB.Extensibility.Scripts^{^ public class RunCustomScript : ScriptBase, IScript^ {^ ^ public override void OnDesignVariableChanged(int optVarId, string variableCurrentValue)^ {^ Site site = ApiEnvironment.Site;^ Table table = site.GetTable("OptimisationVariables");^ Record record = table.Records.GetRecordFromHandle(optVarId);^^ string optVariableName = record["Name"];^ // Select action for correct script^ // Need to match names given to Custom Script type variables^ // in "OptimisationAnalysis / Variables" dialog^ if (optVariableName == "Custom Script")^ {^ // Actions for first custom script variable^ // MessageBox.Show(scriptName + " : " + optVarId.ToString() + " ; " + variableCurrentValue );^ // Increment Heating Setpoint for "Generic Office Area" by Variable Current Value^ foreach (BuildingBlock block in ActiveBuilding.BuildingBlocks)^ {^ foreach (Zone zone in block.Zones)^ {^ int activityId = zone.GetAttributeAsInt("ActivityTemplateId");^ if (activityId == 1105)^ {^ double heatingSetpoint = zone.GetAttributeAsDouble("HeatingDesignSetPointTemperature"); ^ heatingSetpoint -= double.Parse(variableCurrentValue);^^ zone.SetAttribute("HeatingDesignSetPointTemperature", heatingSetpoint.ToString());^ }^ }^ }^ }^ else if (optVariableName == "Custom Script 2")^ {^ // Actions for second custom script variable^ // ... and so on^^ // Decrement Cooling Setpoint for "Generic Office Area" by Variable Current Value^ foreach (BuildingBlock block in ActiveBuilding.BuildingBlocks)^ {^ foreach (Zone zone in block.Zones)^ {^ int ActivityId = zone.GetAttributeAsInt("ActivityTemplateId");^ if (ActivityId == 1105)^ {^ double coolingSetpoint = zone.GetAttributeAsDouble("ActiveCoolingDesignSetPointTemperature");^ coolingSetpoint += double.Parse(variableCurrentValue);^^ zone.SetAttribute("ActiveCoolingDesignSetPointTemperature", coolingSetpoint.ToString());^^ coolingSetpoint = zone.GetAttributeAsDouble("CoolingSetBackSetPointTemperature");^ coolingSetpoint += double.Parse(variableCurrentValue);^ zone.SetAttribute("CoolingSetBackSetPointTemperature", coolingSetpoint.ToString());^^ }^ }^ }^ }<t><t><t><t><t> ^ }^ }^}^

The norm allows an ACH of 2-6 ACH when conditions at night ^!- time are met. The consiquences are that after the increased ACH happens ^!- on one time step, the conditions are not satisfied for the following ^!- time step...rinse and repeat...which results on the "windows" opening ^!- and closing every two time step cycle. Mostly, people sleep at night. ^!- This is not realistic.^^!- Humans learn and adapt. We will employ a learning algorithm. From ^!- previous time steps, we will monitor the time (time steps) it took for the ^!- room OT drop below the setpoint (tSP). The next allowed increased venting ^!- oppertunity will be delayed by 8 hrs (time steps equal to 8 hours) - tSP.

The norm allows an ACH of 2-6 ACH when conditions at night ^!- time are met. The consiquences are that after the increased ACH happens ^!- on one time step, the conditions are not satisfied for the following ^!- time step...rinse and repeat...which results on the "windows" opening ^!- and closing every two time step cycle. Mostly, people sleep at night. ^!- This is not realistic. ^ ^!- Humans learn and adapt. We will employ a learning algorithm. From ^!- previous time steps, we will monitor the time (time steps) it took for the ^!- room OT drop below the setpoint (tSP). The next allowed increased venting ^!- oppertunity will be delayed by 8 hrs (time steps equal to 8 hours) - tSP.

#203 #DIN 4108-2 2013-02 NIGHT WINDOW VENT CROSS LEVEL #1 #as Night Window Vent but with the additional support of level to level ventilation such as atria #0 #!-The EMS Code below is to be used with DesignBuilder v7 and the EMS Module. ^ ^!-If there is Mechanical Ventilation, Define the mechanical ODA ventilation CAPACITY on the Activities Tab ^ ^!-Before using this EMS ensure that you have in DesignBuilder set: ^ ^!-0) Under Model Options select simple HVAC and Autosize with energyplus ^!-1) The site is called TRY2010_02_Jahr,TRY2010_04_Jahr or TRY2010_12_Jahr...this defines the Climate Zone ^!-2) The Building is called Residential or NonResidential ^!-2) The critical block and critical zone are called CriticalBlock and CriticalZone respectively ^!-3)the correct WeatherData set loaded in the ^!- main interface corrisponding to the ^!- required climate zone: ^!-Climate Zone A: TRY-Zone 2 ^!-Climate Zone B: TRY-Zone 4 ^!-Climate Zone C: TRY-Zone 12 ^!- and set simulation to start on Monday ^ ^!-4) Load the Activity Tempelate "Activity_DIN4108_2013_R" for residential or ^!- Activity_DIN4108_2013_NR for nonresidential ^!- at building level. ^!-5) HVAC TAB ^!- Loaded the HVAC Tempelate "HVAC_4108-2"; ^!- Mechanical operation schedule MV_DIN4108 must be loaded, but not changed; ^!- The schedule MV_DIN4108 is always zero, thus Mech Vent is ignored. ^!-6) Loaded the Lighting Tempelate "<none>" ^!-7) Model Infiltration must be turned off on the Construction Tab at building level ^!-8) Turn on the EMS for default shading "DIN 4108-2 2013-02 DEFAULT SHADING" or define custom shading ^!- Turn on interior blinds shading on the openings tab ^ ^!------------------------------------End of User Section-------------------------------- ^EnergyManagementSystem:Program, ^ Innitialize_Globals, ^ ^<If SiteAttribute TitleSite = TRY2010_02_Jahr Then> ^ Set CZ=2, !-please enter 2, 4 or 12 here for required TRY-Zone Number; The norm allows an ACH of 2-6 ACH when conditions at night ^!- time are met. The consiquences are that after the increased ACH happens ^!- on one time step, the conditions are not satisfied for the following ^!- time step...rinse and repeat...which results on the "windows" opening ^!- and closing every two time step cycle. Mostly, people sleep at night. ^!- This is not realistic. ^ ^!- Humans learn and adapt. We will employ a learning algorithm. From ^!- previous time steps, we will monitor the time (time steps) it took for the ^!- room OT drop below the setpoint (tSP). The next allowed increased venting ^!- oppertunity will be delayed by 8 hrs (time steps equal to 8 hours) - tSP.

The norm allows an ACH of 2-6 ACH when conditions at night ^!- time are met. The consiquences are that after the increased ACH happens ^!- on one time step, the conditions are not satisfied for the following ^!- time step...rinse and repeat...which results on the "windows" opening ^!- and closing every two time step cycle. Mostly, people sleep at night. ^!- This is not realistic. ^ ^!- Humans learn and adapt. We will employ a learning algorithm. From ^!- previous time steps, we will monitor the time (time steps) it took for the ^!- room OT drop below the setpoint (tSP). The next allowed increased venting ^!- oppertunity will be delayed by 8 hrs (time steps equal to 8 hours) - tSP.
